SELECT r.id, r.name, r.vehicle_id AS vehicleId, v.plate_number AS vehiclePlate, v.brand AS vehicleBrand, v.driver_name AS driverName, r.station_count AS stationCount, r.total_passenger AS totalPassenger, r.capacity, r.occupancy_rate AS occupancyRate, r.total_distance AS totalDistance, r.estimated_time AS estimatedTime, r.departure_time AS departureTime, r.status, r.color, r.create_time AS createTime FROM biz_route r LEFT JOIN biz_vehicle v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.name ASC

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.vehicle_id AS vehicleId, v.plate_number AS vehiclePlate, v.brand AS vehicleBrand, v.driver_name AS driverName, r.station_count AS stationCount, r.total_passenger AS totalPassenger, r.capacity, r.occupancy_rate AS occupancyRate, r.total_distance AS totalDistance, r.estimated_time AS estimatedTime, r.departure_time AS departureTime, r.status, r.color, r.create_time AS createTime FROM biz_route r LEFT JOIN biz_vehicle v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
